title: yizhiyanhua-ai/fireworks-tech-graph
claim: yizhiyanhua-ai/fireworks-tech-graph — Generate production-quality SVG+PNG technical diagrams from natural language. 7 styles, UML support, and AI/Agent workfl
why_good: fireworks-tech-graph is an Agent Skill that works in Codex and Claude Code, turning natural language into geometry-checked SVG, high-res PNG, and animated GIFs. It supports 12 styles, all 14 UML diagram types, and AI/Agent domain patterns, with executable contracts for C4, cloud, events, and reliability.
value: Developers and architects pay for a tool that saves them hours per week in diagram creation, especially those in AI/agent infrastructure who need to document complex systems quickly.
risk: Mermaid or a major AI IDE could integrate text-to-diagram natively, killing the need for a separate tool.

zh.claim: 停止手动绘制图表。用英语或中文描述你的系统——获得几何安全的 SVG、PNG、聚焦的 SVG 转 GIF 动画，以及离线交互式技术图表。
zh.hook: 开发者和架构师在 draw.io 或 Excalidraw 等工具中手动绘制系统图表浪费大量时间，他们需要一种直接从自然语言生成精美、准确图表的方法。
zh.does: fireworks-tech-graph 是一个 Agent 技能，可在 Codex 和 Claude Code 中运行，将自然语言转换为经过几何检查的 SVG、高分辨率 PNG 和动画 GIF。它支持 12 种样式、全部 14 种 UML 图类型以及 AI/Agent 领域模式，并为 C4、云、事件和可靠性提供可执行契约。
zh.why_use: 与通用图表工具不同，它能生成生产级、几何安全的图表，并带有语义动画，且深度集成到 AI 编码代理中，使开发人员无需离开工作流程即可生成图表。
zh.gap: 它是一个 CLI/自托管的技能，而不是一个完善的产品；非技术用户或想要 GUI 或 SaaS 的用户会感到困难。尽管支持中文输入，但中国市场案例也是空的。
zh.counter: Mermaid 和 PlantUML 已经占据了文本转图表领域，而 Cursor 或 GitHub Copilot 等 AI IDE 可能通过一次更新添加类似功能，使其成为功能而非公司。
zh.differentiator: 将其打包为具有 GUI 的用户友好型 Web 应用或 VS Code 扩展，并针对中国市场进行本地化，提供模板和对中国云提供商的支持。
zh.value: 开发者和架构师付费购买能每周节省数小时图表创建时间的工具，尤其是那些在 AI/代理基础设施领域需要快速记录复杂系统的人。
zh.risk: Mermaid 或主流 AI IDE 可能会原生集成文本转图表功能，从而消除对单独工具的需求。
zh.why_good: fireworks-tech-graph 是一个 Agent 技能，可在 Codex 和 Claude Code 中运行，将自然语言转换为经过几何检查的 SVG、高分辨率 PNG 和动画 GIF。它支持 12 种样式、全部 14 种 UML 图类型以及 AI/Agent 领域模式，并为 C4、云、事件和可靠性提供可执行契约。

does: fireworks-tech-graph is an Agent Skill that works in Codex and Claude Code, turning natural language into geometry-checked SVG, high-res PNG, and animated GIFs. It supports 12 styles, all 14 UML diagram types, and AI/Agent domain patterns, with executable contracts for C4, cloud, events, and reliability.
edge: The AI-authored 'Dark Luxury' style offers a unique aesthetic that is not available in competing tools.
why_use: Unlike generic diagram tools, it produces production-quality, geometry-safe diagrams with semantic motion, and it's deeply integrated into AI coding agents, so developers can generate diagrams without leaving their workflow.
hook: Developers and architects waste hours manually drawing system diagrams in tools like draw.io or Excalidraw, and they need a way to generate polished, accurate diagrams directly from natural language descriptions.

gap: No verified demand; stars are attention, not proof of willingness to pay or real pain.
counter: Mermaid and PlantUML already own the text-to-diagram space, and AI IDEs like Cursor or GitHub Copilot could add a similar feature with one update, making this a feature, not a company.
differentiator: Package it as a user-friendly web app or VS Code extension with a GUI, and localize it for the Chinese market with templates and support for Chinese cloud providers.
pick_reason: Popular but lacks first-hand evidence of demand; agent-infra tool with no clear consumer angle.
